en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban, from Zurara who said,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with them buying a land of the Zimmy when they develop it and revive it, so it is for them’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Aban from Zurarah who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not unlawful if tax payers buy land, if they build and revive it, it becomes their land.’”
